title: Split Array With Same Average
summary: Given an integer array nums, determine if it's possible to divide the elements into two non-empty arrays A and B such that the average of elements in A equals the average of elements in B.
statement: Given an integer array nums, determine if it's possible to divide the elements into two non-empty arrays A and B such that the average of elements in A equals the average of elements in B.
constraints: nums contains at least two nonnegative integers.
Split it into two nonempty groups whose averages are equal.
Return whether such a split exists.
hints: A subset of size k must have sum total*k/n.
Build reachable sums by subset size, updating sizes downward for each value.
Check sizes one through half only.
Downward updates use each input once, and any valid larger group has a complementary valid group no larger than half.
editorial: Downward updates use each input once, and any valid larger group has a complementary valid group no larger than half.

tests.explanation: The values can be divided into groups with common average four and one half.
Two unequal singleton groups cannot have the same average.
